answer: The tide cap is policed at intake and timber exposes the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a marble tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The fee repeats 29 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
